name: Onnayu de Tousatsu Sareta Tsuma
source:
What would you think if someone photographed your wife in the bath?

"Peep on ladies bathing"
You found a special website.
But you never imagined you'd see your own spouse on camera!
You're not the only one watching - three other men too!
She has no idea she's being peeped on. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080769.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
如果有人拍到你妻子洗澡，你会怎么想？

《偷看女士洗澡》你发现了一个特殊的网站。
但你从未想过你会在镜头前看到自己的配偶！
你不是唯一一个在观看的人 - 还有另外三个人！
她不知道自己正在被偷看。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080769.html]DLsite English[/url]]
